name: Zoning_2026
title: Platteville Zoning (2026)
description:
This layer contains the official zoning designations for parcels located within the City of Platteville limits. 

This dataset serves as the authoritative source layer for zoning information within the City and supports related web maps, applications, and hosted feature layer views. Updates to zoning classifications should be made directly to this source layer.
snippet: Official zoning designations within the municipal boundaries, current as of June 2026
